text.text:
As an event planner, I have worked with the Bronx Design team for over 10 years for all my printing needs. That’s why, when I needed a printer for my wedding signage, program, and menus, I knew who to call. Danielle was a rockstar. She worked with me to find the best thick card stock and even printed proofs for me to review before we placed our order. She was always responsive and took the time to answer all my questions.

When you work with Bronx Design, you are getting a personal touch, detailed service, and you get to work with people who care about each project. They don’t make them like this anymore. I highly recommend Bronx Design for all your printing needs. There is no better group of people, and they are a family-run and women-owned business!
